description: Diagnose a failed or surprising n8n execution. Paste the execution JSON (from the n8n UI 'Show details' or `GET /executions/:id?includeData=true`); returns a per-node summary highlighting nodes that returned 0 items, unresolved `={{ ... }}` expressions, errors with hints, and LLM token usage. Hits the most common debugging pain point: items 'silently disappearing' between nodes. Deterministic, rule-based.

execution.description: n8n execution payload (REST `?includeData=true` shape or raw UI export). Object or JSON string.

name: execution_explain

findings.description: Per-node findings extracted from the execution payload.

title: Explain a failed n8n execution
